---
title: "Week 14: Handling Many Models"
---

## Official Topic

Handling many models.

## Problem Focus

How do we compare many models without losing sight of the question?

Students apply the same modeling workflow across groups and summarize patterns while preserving diagnostics.

## In Class

- Nest or split data by group.
- Fit repeated models.
- Extract comparable summaries.
- Identify groups where the model fails.

## AI-Aware Task

Ask an LLM to rank several models. Then decide whether the ranking uses an appropriate metric and whether diagnostics were considered.
